summary: Tested the Outstanding List 'Settled chhupao' feature on backend and frontend. Found 2 CRITICAL bugs and fixed both (each a one-line fix): (1) backend: the @api.get('/reports/outstanding') decorator was sitting on the new helper _settled_now_map() instead of outstanding_report(), so the endpoint returned {} and the whole Outstanding page was broken; (2) frontend: hideSettled was missing from the useEffect deps in Outstanding.jsx, so the toggle changed the URL and pill colour but did not refetch. The list, count, totals, print header and Excel all stayed one step behind until a reload. After the fixes, all requested checks pass.

critical.issue: The route decorator was on _settled_now_map (the helper was inserted between the decorator and outstanding_report), so the endpoint returned {} with no params. FIXED by moving the decorator back onto outstanding_report.

minor.issue: The test hardcodes count==218, but the live data now has a different count. The test is stale; the app is fine.

ui_bugs.issue: hideSettled was not in the dependency array, so toggling did not refetch (stale rows, count, totals, header and Excel). FIXED by adding it.

action_items: Review the 2 fixes I made (server.py decorator placement; Outstanding.jsx useEffect deps)
Update the stale hardcoded count (218) in tests/test_outstanding.py or make it data-independent
critical_code_review_comments: When you add helper functions, check that they don't end up between a route decorator and its handler. A stray '# ---------- TRIAL BALANCE ----------' header was also above the outstanding block; I renamed it to OUTSTANDING.
_settled_now_map runs one find_one plus one _compute_party_balance per settled party on every outstanding request (N+1). Fine for now, but it could be batched.
server.py is over 3000 lines and should be split into routers.
